answer_1.quote: Zero-Shot Text to Speech Given a target text and a reference speech as input, zero-shot TTS systems aim to synthesize the target text while mimicking the reference style.

answer_2.quote: For objective metrics, we evaluate the intelligibility (WER, ↓), speaker similarity (SIM, ↑), and overall speech quality (UT-MOS , ↑).

answer_4.quote: We further conducted subjective evaluation to verify its alignment with human perception.
answer_4.guideline: given a text and a speech, subjects perform binary classification to determine whether the speech accurately reads the text without any content insertion, omission, or mispronunciation.
